~~~~~~~~~~
Deckoviz is an AI-powered Dynamic Art Frame, a first-in-the-market product designed to make people's spaces come alive with personalized, intelligent, and dynamic art. The product is built on a 32-inch Android TV modality, and is operated through our companion app. It is also customizable for different use cases. Our target customers will be real estate developers, home owners with a sophisticated taste in art and home personalization tech, hotels, large electronics stores, architects and interior designers, home decor shops, restaurants, and shops that want to personalize their spaces. 


Deckoviz is an AI-powered Smart Art Frame that creates personalized, dynamic and immersive art experiences for people in their homes and other spaces. It is an AI hardware device that understands a user's preferences, tastes, moods, states, etc at a deep level, to create, curate, and display personalized visual experiences, including multimodal art experiences. We have loads of exciting features, like real time story visualization, personal painter to help process emotions, moodscapes and moodswingers, intelligent display, ambient setting sycing, smart music syncing, and lots more. We want to infuse homes and spaces with more joy, wonder, creativity, connection, and personality.
Deckoviz: High-Level Project Overview
Project Description
Deckoviz is an AI-powered digital art frame and smart display system that allows users to curate, modify, and display artworks on a smart TV hardware device via a mobile app. The system supports AI-powered style transfer, generative art, dynamic image collections, a digital art marketplace, and personalized recommendations to create a next-generation, interactive art experience.


Users can:
* Upload and manage their personal art collections
* Apply AI transformations to images (style transfer, background changes, AI-generated variations, enhancements, editing)
* Create themed image collections with custom display preferences
* Purchase and sell digital art via a marketplace
* Connect and sync with a smart display device for immersive visuals
* Display visuals on the screen based on their preferences 
________________


🔧 Tech Stack
Frontend (User Interface Layer)
* Mobile App: React Native (cross-platform for iOS & Android)
* Web App: React.js (for marketplace, dashboard, and web interface)
* State Management: Redux (for UI state and global settings)
* UI Framework: Tailwind CSS (for responsive, modern design)
Backend (Application Logic & APIs)
* Backend Framework: Python (FastAPI / Django for RESTful API development)
* Database: PostgreSQL (relational database for user data, collections, marketplace)
* Vector Database: Pinecone / Weaviate (for AI-powered search and recommendations)
* Authentication: Firebase Auth / Auth0 (for secure login and account management)
AI & Image Processing
* AI Style Transfer & Image Editing: TensorFlow / PyTorch
* AI Image Generation: Stable Diffusion / OpenAI DALL·E
* AI-Powered Search & Recommendations: CLIP (for text-to-image matching)
* Background Removal & Modifications: U-Net segmentation models
Storage & Hosting
* Cloud Storage: AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage (for user-uploaded images & videos)
* Backend Hosting: AWS EC2 / Google Cloud Run / Azure Functions
* CDN & Load Balancing: Cloudflare / AWS CloudFront (for content delivery and fast access)
Smart TV Connectivity & Syncing
* Communication Protocols: WebSockets, MQTT (for real-time updates between mobile and smart display)
* Integration with Smart TVs:
   * React Native for TV (for smart TV app interface)
   * Chromecast / AirPlay support (for screen mirroring & casting)
________________


📜 Feature Development Process (User Stories → Code Generation)
Each feature follows this workflow:
1. User Story Definition (What the user wants to achieve)
2. Technical Breakdown (APIs, models, components required)
3. Code Generation & Development (Write backend & frontend code based on the architecture)
4. Testing & Deployment
For example:
🔹 Feature: AI Style Transfer Screen
User Story:
As a user, I want to apply AI-based style transfer to my images by selecting a pre-set style or describing the style in text.
Technical Breakdown:
* Frontend:
   * UI screen (React Native) for selecting an image and choosing a style
   * API request to backend with image + style parameters
* Backend:
   * Python FastAPI endpoint to handle AI style transfer requests
   * Process image using TensorFlow/PyTorch model
   * Return modified images
* Storage & Database:
   * Save processed images in cloud storage
   * Store references in PostgreSQL for later retrieval
Code Generation & Implementation:
* Frontend React Native code for image selection & API call
* Backend FastAPI Python function to process and return AI-modified images
* Database schema updates to store style transfer history

High-Level Design and Software Architecture for Deckoviz
1. Overview
Deckoviz is an AI-powered smart art frame designed on a smart TV modality, seamlessly integrated with a mobile app. It provides deeply personalized AI-curated art experiences, AI-generated paintings, dynamic displays based on mood and context, an AI-powered marketplace for digital and AI art, immersive multimodal experiences, and smart lighting integration.
2. Core Functional Modules
2.1 Smart Art Frame & Display System
* AI-Powered Dynamic Display: Artwork changes based on time, mood, preferences, and ambient conditions.

* Intelligent Scheduling: Users can set daily, weekly, or event-based rotation schedules.

* Local & Cloud-Based Content: Displays user-uploaded images, marketplace purchases, or AI-generated art.

* Smart Lighting Integration: Adjusts room lighting to complement artwork display.

2.2 AI Curation & Personalization
   * User Preferences & Behavioral Analysis: AI learns from user engagement and reactions.

   * Mood-Based Art Selection: AI curates artwork based on real-time mood detection from facial expression analysis, voice tone, or manual input.

   * Time & Context-Aware Recommendations: Different artwork for morning, evening, special occasions, etc.

2.3 AI-Generated Art & Style Transfer
      * AI Painting Creation: Uses generative models to create new artwork based on user prompts.

      * Style Transfer Feature: Applies famous painting styles (Van Gogh, Picasso, Impressionism, etc.) to user-uploaded images.

      * Customization Tools: Users can fine-tune AI-generated paintings.

2.4 Marketplace for AI & Digital Art
         * Buy & Sell AI and Digital Art: Artists can upload and sell digital and AI-generated artwork.

         * Smart Recommendations: AI suggests art pieces based on user taste.

         * NFT & Blockchain Integration (Future Expansion): Potentially supports NFT-based ownership verification.

2.5 Multimodal Immersive Art Experiences
            * Interactive Audio-Visual Art: Artwork responds to sound and environment changes.

            * Immersive Storytelling Mode: AI curates a sequence of art pieces that narrate a visual story.

            * Augmented Reality (Future Expansion): AR overlays for interactive art exploration.

2.6 Natural Language Search & AI Discovery
               * Conversational Search: Users can find artwork using natural language (e.g., "Show me a calm beach at sunset").

               * AI-Powered Visual Ideas & Recommendations: AI suggests new art styles, quotes, and daily inspiration.

2.7 Personalized Quotes, Poems & Passage Posters
                  * Daily AI-Generated Quotes & Poems: Inspirational or themed content based on user interests.

                  * Custom Poster Creator: Users can generate quote-based posters in different styles.

2.8 Questions Card Feature
                     * Daily Thought-Provoking Questions: AI selects interesting questions to engage users.

                     * Interactive Mode: Users can discuss and answer with friends or family.

2.9 Gamification & Engagement
                        * User Engagement Levels: Users earn experience points (XP) for interacting with the platform.

                        * Badges & Achievements: Unlock badges for exploring different art categories, creating AI art, and engaging with the community.

                        * Daily & Weekly Challenges: Users receive personalized challenges to explore new art styles, participate in themed art days, or complete curation goals.

                        * Leaderboard & Social Features: Users can share achievements, compete in art appreciation challenges, and interact with a community of art enthusiasts.

                        * Subscription & Rewards System: Premium users get access to exclusive AI art models, enhanced personalization, and special marketplace discounts.

3. Software Architecture
3.1 High-Level Architecture
Deckoviz follows a microservices-based architecture with modular components.
Frontend (Smart TV & Mobile App)
                           * Technologies: React Native (Mobile), React/Next.js (Web), Tizen/Android TV (Smart Frame UI)

                           * UI Framework: Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI

                           * State Management: Redux / Zustand

                           * Authentication: OAuth, JWT

                           * API Communication: GraphQL & REST Hybrid

Backend (API & Services)
                              * Technologies: Python (FastAPI) / Node.js (NestJS)

                              * Microservices-Based Architecture:

                                 * Art Curation & Personalization Engine

                                 * AI Art Generation & Style Transfer Service

                                 * Marketplace Service

                                 * User Profile & Preferences Service

                                 * Smart Display & Scheduling Service

                                 * Natural Language Search Engine

                                 * Notifications & Engagement Engine

                                 * Multimodal Processing Engine (Audio-Visual Interactions)

                                    * Authentication & Security: OAuth2, JWT, End-to-End Encryption

AI & Machine Learning Layer
                                       * Generative AI Models:

                                          * Stable Diffusion / DALL·E (AI Art Generation)

                                          * StyleGAN (Style Transfer)

                                          * CLIP (Image-Text Matching for Search)

                                             * Reinforcement Learning:

                                                * Adaptive Art Curation (Improves personalization over time)

                                                   * Natural Language Processing:

                                                      * GPT-4 Fine-Tuned (For Quotes, Poems, and Conversational Search)

Database & Storage
                                                         * Primary Database: PostgreSQL / MongoDB (User Data, Artwork Metadata)

                                                         * Vector Database: Pinecone / FAISS (For AI-powered search & recommendations)

                                                         * Blob Storage: AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage (For images, videos, art files)

                                                         * Cache & Performance Optimization: Redis / Memcached

Messaging & Real-Time Communication
                                                            * WebSockets / MQTT: For real-time interactions

                                                            * Push Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)

                                                            * Email & SMS Integration: Twilio, SendGrid

DevOps & Infrastructure
                                                               * Cloud Platform: AWS / Google Cloud / Azure

                                                               * Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

                                                               * CI/CD Pipeline: GitHub Actions / Jenkins

                                                               * Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack

4. Security & Privacy Considerations
                                                                  * Data Encryption: Ensures secure transmission and storage of user data.

                                                                  * AI Fairness & Bias Mitigation: Regular audits to ensure AI recommendations are unbiased.

                                                                  * User-Controlled AI Settings: Users can customize AI curation and personalization settings.

                                                                  * Role-Based Access Controls: Marketplace and user management with defined roles.

5. Scalability & Future Expansions
                                                                     * Multi-Region Deployment: Ensures global reach and low latency.

                                                                     * Multi-Language Support: Expands accessibility to a wider audience.

                                                                     * Smart Home & IoT Integration: Compatibility with Alexa, Google Home, and Smart Home ecosystems.

                                                                     * Enterprise & B2B Use Cases: Galleries, corporate spaces, hospitality industry integration.

                                                                     * Augmented Reality & Holographic Displays: Future expansions for enhanced art experiences.

6. Conclusion
Deckoviz is designed with an AI-first, user-personalized approach to redefine digital art experiences. With seamless smart TV integration, advanced AI curation, a dynamic marketplace, and immersive multimodal features, it offers an unparalleled digital and AI art experience. By continuously evolving with AI and user engagement insights, Deckoviz aims to become the leading smart art platform for homes and businesses alike.

Section 1: Functional Requirements
Project Name: Deckoviz 
Version: 1.0
Date: April 2, 2024


1. Purpose
Deckoviz aims to redefine how people experience and interact with digital art. By merging AI, creativity, and smart display technology, Deckoviz provides an immersive, dynamic, and deeply personal art experience. The platform enables users to curate, customize, and showcase artwork that evolves with their tastes, moods, and environments. Whether for personal enjoyment, professional spaces, or as a marketplace for creators, Deckoviz bridges the gap between static art and intelligent, adaptive displays.
2. Scope
Deckoviz encompasses:
                                                                                                                     1. Hardware (AI-Powered Digital Frame & Smart TV Integration)
                                                                                                                     * A high-resolution digital display with embedded AI for real-time processing.
                                                                                                                     * Smart TV integration to allow users to display art on their existing devices.
                                                                                                                     * Wireless connectivity with the mobile app for seamless content updates and controls.
                                                                                                                     2. Mobile App (Core User Interface & Controls)
                                                                                                                     * Upload, manage, and curate personal art collections.
                                                                                                                     * Apply AI-driven modifications, such as style transfers and generative art.
                                                                                                                     * Purchase, browse, and discover digital artwork from an integrated marketplace.
                                                                                                                     * Customize display settings, including schedules, transitions, and music.
                                                                                                                     3. AI & Cloud-Based Personalization
                                                                                                                     * Adaptive display curation based on user preferences, time of day, or mood.
                                                                                                                     * AI-powered recommendations for new artwork.
                                                                                                                     * Generative art features allowing users to create unique pieces.
                                                                                                                     4. Marketplace & Community Engagement
                                                                                                                     * A platform for artists to showcase and sell their digital works.
                                                                                                                     * Community engagement through likes, shares, and artist discovery.




Project Overview


                                                                                                                     * Vision Statement: Concisely summarize the core purpose of the app.
Deckoviz transforms living spaces into dynamic art experiences by seamlessly blending AI, creativity, and personalization. Our smart AI-powered art frame and platform empower users to curate, display, and interact with digital and AI-generated art, making every home, office, or space an evolving canvas of inspiration.


                                                                                                                     * Goals and Objectives: Define what you want to achieve with the app.
                                                                                                                     1. Revolutionize Digital Art Display – Offer a next-gen AI-powered art frame that goes beyond static images, allowing interactive, evolving, and intelligently curated displays.
                                                                                                                     2. Seamless AI-Powered Customization – Provide AI-driven style transfers, generative art, and personalized recommendations to elevate creativity.
                                                                                                                     3. Create a Thriving Art Marketplace – Connect users with artists and creators, enabling them to discover, purchase, and showcase stunning digital artworks.
                                                                                                                     4. Enhance User Engagement – Enable users to build collections, personalize their art experience, and dynamically control their displays through an intuitive mobile app.
                                                                                                                     5. Bridge Technology and Aesthetics – Ensure that Deckoviz seamlessly integrates into modern homes and professional spaces as a visually compelling and technologically advanced solution.


                                                                                                                     * Target Audience: Describe the ideal users for your app.
Art Enthusiasts & Collectors – People who appreciate fine art and want to curate their own digital collections.
Homeowners & Interior Designers – Individuals and professionals looking to enhance spaces with dynamic, customizable digital art.
Tech-Savvy Consumers – Early adopters interested in AI, smart home devices, and digital experiences.
Artists & Creators – Digital artists seeking a platform to showcase and sell their work.
Business Owners & Office Spaces – Hotels, cafes, and corporate offices looking to display dynamic, engaging visual content.


                                                                                                                     * Problem Statement: Outline the specific problem(s) the app intends to solve.
Traditional framed art and static digital screens limit the way people interact with and enjoy visual creativity. Existing smart displays lack personalization, AI-driven curation, and seamless integration with a user’s evolving taste. Deckoviz solves this by providing an intelligent, AI-powered art display system that:
                                                                                                                     * Allows users to dynamically change and personalize their displayed art.
                                                                                                                     * Offers AI-powered transformations and generative art capabilities.
                                                                                                                     * Connects users to a marketplace of curated digital art.
                                                                                                                     * Seamlessly integrates with smart home environments and user preferences.


Functional Requirements
1️⃣ User Management
                                                                                                                     * User registration and authentication (email, social login).
                                                                                                                     * Profile management (name, preferences, favorite art styles, etc.).
                                                                                                                     * Multi-device synchronization for seamless access across hardware and mobile.
                                                                                                                     * Subscription or premium-tier access for exclusive content and AI features.
                                                                                                                     * Sign-up/Login: Smooth registration using email/social media, secure password management.
                                                                                                                     * Profile Creation: Users enter details like age, reading interests, goals, and initial reading level assessment.
                                                                                                                     * Profile Management: Editing, updating information, and setting preferences.
2️⃣ Content Handling & Curation
                                                                                                                     * Upload images from the device or cloud storage.
                                                                                                                     * Organize images into collections and meta-collections.
                                                                                                                     * AI-powered style transfer to modify and enhance images.
                                                                                                                     * Generative AI features for creating unique art pieces from prompts.
                                                                                                                     * Intelligent search and discovery (text-based and visual search).
3️⃣ Customization & Personalization
                                                                                                                     * Set display preferences (timing, rotation, sequencing).
                                                                                                                     * Choose music or ambient sounds to accompany art collections.
                                                                                                                     * Adaptive AI-powered display suggestions based on viewing patterns.
                                                                                                                     * Integration with smart home assistants (Alexa, Google Assistant).
                                                                                                                     * Ability to modify images via text or visual prompts (e.g., change backgrounds).
4️⃣ Marketplace & Commerce
                                                                                                                     * Discover and purchase digital artwork.
                                                                                                                     * Support for multiple payment methods.
                                                                                                                     * Artist profiles with featured work and pricing details.
                                                                                                                     * Secure licensing and digital ownership verification.
5️⃣ Tracking & Analytics
                                                                                                                     * Monitor most displayed and liked artworks.
                                                                                                                     * Generate insights on user preferences for better recommendations.
                                                                                                                     * Engagement metrics for artists (e.g., views, purchases, user interactions).

Tech Stack & Architecture
________________


🌐 Tech Stack
Frontend Development
                                                                                                                     * Mobile App: React Native (for cross-platform iOS & Android development)
                                                                                                                     * Web App: React.js (for marketplace, user portal, and web-based interactions)
                                                                                                                     * State Management: Redux (for managing global state across mobile and web)
                                                                                                                     * UI Framework: Tailwind CSS (for clean, responsive UI)
Backend Development
                                                                                                                     * Backend Framework: Python (FastAPI or Django for API services)
                                                                                                                     * Database: PostgreSQL (for structured data storage)
                                                                                                                     * Vector Database: Pinecone or Weaviate (for AI-based search and recommendations)
                                                                                                                     * Authentication & User Management: Firebase Auth or Auth0
                                                                                                                     * AI Processing:
                                                                                                                     * TensorFlow / PyTorch (for AI-generated images and style transfer)
                                                                                                                     * OpenAI’s DALL·E / Stable Diffusion (for AI-generated art)


Cloud & Hosting
                                                                                                                     * Cloud Provider: AWS / Google Cloud / Azure (for scalability and reliability)
                                                                                                                     * Storage:
                                                                                                                     * Image & Video Storage: AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage
                                                                                                                     * Database Hosting: AWS RDS / Google Cloud SQL
                                                                                                                     * Vector Database Hosting: Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus
                                                                                                                     * Backend Hosting: AWS EC2 / Google App Engine / Azure Functions
                                                                                                                     * CDN & Load Balancing: Cloudflare / AWS CloudFront (for performance and security)
                                                                                                                     * Real-Time Communication: WebSockets (for instant updates, e.g., new artwork sync)
Mobile App ↔ Smart TV Connection
                                                                                                                     * Communication Protocol: WebSockets & MQTT (for real-time updates between mobile & TV)
                                                                                                                     * Integration Method:
                                                                                                                     * Mobile app discovers and connects to the Smart TV via local WiFi / Bluetooth
                                                                                                                     * Smart TV runs a lightweight client (React Native for TV / Tizen for Samsung TVs)
                                                                                                                     * Mobile app sends commands (e.g., update display, change collections) via API calls
                                                                                                                     * Alternative Streaming Method:
                                                                                                                     * Chromecast / AirPlay support for screen mirroring
                                                                                                                     * Direct Smart TV app development for major platforms (Tizen, WebOS, Android TV)
AI & ML Components
                                                                                                                     * Style Transfer & Image Modification:
                                                                                                                     * Deep Learning models (FastAPI server serving TensorFlow/PyTorch models)
                                                                                                                     * Pre-trained models for common styles + user-input-based fine-tuning
                                                                                                                     * Image Search & Recommendations:
                                                                                                                     * CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) for text-based image search
                                                                                                                     * Nearest-neighbor search via Pinecone vector DB
                                                                                                                     * AI-driven personalized art suggestions based on viewing patterns
                                                                                                                     * Generative AI:
                                                                                                                     * Stable Diffusion / OpenAI DALL·E for AI-generated art
                                                                                                                     * Background modification using text/image inputs
                                                                                                                     * AI-assisted image improvements (e.g., portrait enhancements, GIF creation)
________________


📐 Architecture Overview
1️⃣ Mobile & Web App Layer (Client-Side)
                                                                                                                     * React Native App (for user interaction, collections, settings, uploads)
                                                                                                                     * React Web App (for marketplace, user dashboard, artist profiles)
                                                                                                                     * WebSockets / MQTT (for real-time communication with Smart TV)
2️⃣ API & Backend Layer
                                                                                                                     * FastAPI / Django REST API (handles user requests, image processing, AI features)
                                                                                                                     * GraphQL / REST API (for efficient querying of art collections & user preferences)
                                                                                                                     * User Authentication (Firebase Auth / Auth0)
3️⃣ AI Processing Layer
                                                                                                                     * AI Style Transfer & Modifications (Runs on cloud GPUs via AWS/GCP)
                                                                                                                     * AI Image Generation (DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Deep Dream for art creation)
                                                                                                                     * Recommendation Engine (CLIP model + vector DB for personalized suggestions)
4️⃣ Database & Storage Layer
                                                                                                                     * PostgreSQL (Primary Database) (For structured user and app data)
                                                                                                                     * Vector Database (Pinecone / Weaviate) (For image similarity search & recommendations)
                                                                                                                     * AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage (For image and video asset management)
5️⃣ Smart TV & Hardware Layer
                                                                                                                     * Embedded AI Chipset (For real-time display rendering & adaptive curation)
                                                                                                                     * Display Algorithm (Determines which images to show based on settings & AI recommendations)
                                                                                                                     * Device Sync via API (Mobile app sends updates, TV fetches new images via REST/WebSockets)
________________


🛠️ Additional Considerations
✅ Offline Mode:
                                                                                                                     * Smart TV caches the last synced collection for offline playback.
✅ Security & Encryption:
                                                                                                                     * End-to-end encryption for user data & image transfers.
                                                                                                                     * Secure API access using OAuth 2.0 / JWT tokens.
✅ Scalability:
                                                                                                                     * Load balancers & auto-scaling (AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes for container orchestration).
✅ Third-Party Integrations:
                                                                                                                     * Payment processing (Stripe / PayPal for marketplace transactions).
                                                                                                                     * Social media integration for sharing collections & favorite artwork.
Comprehensive backend plan. This plan covers crucial aspects like technology choices, architecture, data handling, AI integration, security, and scalability.

	User Story/Feature/Functionality 
	Additional Notes
	

	User profile creation:
Allow the user to create and edit profile - which gets converted to a vector model as the user persona model 
So we create two instances of the user persona - one in a structured and unstructured format in a conventional DB, one in a vector database 
[This user model will be used for multiple functions, for instance, for the personal painter feature, for image recommendations, for preferences, etc] 
	

	

	Profile creation 


Structured format 


Vector embeddings 


Video embeddings


Voice embeddings 




	

	

	Onboarding: The system shall engage in a voice conversation with the user, asking 10 generic questions, and 10 personalized questions - this needs to be conversational, interactive, fun, interspersed with wit, humour, personal touches as it learns more about the user, 


The onboarding experience:
Fully voice based 
The system shall ask the user questions, from our onboarding session questions list. 
The system shall adjust and adapt the questions and its style based on the users responses. 
The session will go on for a minimum of 40 minutes, and until 1 core questions have been answered, with enough information gleaned for a base level user persona model generation, and 2 the user is satisfied with the length of the onboarding sesion voice chat. 


We want to make the onboarding session feel as fun, enjoyable, interactive, value-providing (instead of it being used just as a way for the AI to understand and model the user, we want the user to also get value - in terms of having a fun, humorous, lively conversation, maybe even uncovering something new about themselves or the world in the process), personalized as possible, having our AI be witty, personalized and human in its response. 


Once the voice chat is completed, a transcript is generated, and it is used to create a deep user persona model (who is the user, how do they think about life, about things, their hobbies, passions, interests, their lifestyles, their relationships, their values, their priorities and goals, their hopes and dreams, their ideal lifestyle, their current struggles and issues, etc)
A message is also sent to the user’s email, where the AI lays out its interpretation of the user - their values, goals, hopes, etc, with some action tasks. 


Because of cost constraints, we can create a demo of voice mode onboarding, and then used chat messaging onboarding as a placeholder solution until funding is secured 


	

	

	Collection functionality:
Giving the user the ability to create a collection, remove and add images, edit titles and description of the collection, and time and music preferences 
The user can create a collection from scratch, by adding images from their image buckets, or select an existing collection for editing 




Collections are sets of images with collection metadata (collection ID, title, description, music, meta notes) and image metadata 


Collections are what we will be displaying on the frames, not individual images 


Collections can be reordered, they can be edited, deleted, and their meta data can be mutable too. 


	





	

	Authentication 
Allow the user to sign up and login
Account management and analytics  






	

	

	LLM-powered natural language search recommendation engine for images and collections: The user can type out the kinds of images or collections they are looking for, by describing in natural language, including keywords, labels, etc, and we perform a vector based search to find the best-fit images or collections 
We provide two options - individual image search or collection search, allowing the user to toggle for either 


We show a sequence of 100 images for image search, and 20 collections for collection search, in a decreasing order of accuracy or best-fit metric 


We could explore using a CV model and embeddings instead of a mere text based search, for a second, more intricate and enhanced version of image search and recommendation 


The first version of this painting/visual/image recommender won’t use embeddings; instead, we will search through the image descriptions and labels in the image metabucket to return the images with the highest convergence [defined loosely as most number of overlapping labels and words in description]


Eg of flow
The user wants to find a painting which depicts someone on a mountain, with the backdrop of the milky way, gazing ahead solemnly. They describe this in a natural language form, and the system returns images with the highest convergence by searching through image labels and descriptions. 


	

	

	Image-based recommendation system:
Given n reference images in the users image bucket, that include metadata with labels for each image [eg, "stars, night sky, mountain, forest, milky way"], develop a recommendation engine that recommends "similar" [the definition of this term is mouldable in this context - text-based, image-based, cosine similarity based, etc - we could try out various different approaches] images [recommended image sequence going from most similar/most accurate to least similar/accurate] from an image bucket. Add a "next" button for each image, which shows the next most likely image.


	

	

	Style transfer:
The user selects an image from their meta collection.
They then select a style from the dropdown menu. 
The style transfer operation is completed and 3/n copies of the style transfer image is sent to the user. They then select the one[s] they want to save to their collection. 




	

	

	Personal painter:
The personal painter feature is accessed through 3 modes:
                                                                                                                     1. Simple one box prompt 
                                                                                                                     2. Text chat modality, where the user engages in a conversation with the AI so the AI can create the most hyper personalized and richly textured painting - this conversation happens through a chat window - text chat
                                                                                                                     3. Voice modality, which is the same as the chat modality, except the conversation happens with voice mode - instead of texting and reading, the AI asks and listens - this is a voice chat 


Mode (1) The user is prompted to input information about painting style(s), paintings, themes, moods, statements and ideas, emotions and thoughts they want to be evoked through the creation of the personal painter in a box. This is converted into a richly detailed prompt, to be fed to an image model, which returns the personal painting.


User flow for modes (2) and (3) 
The user chats (through voice modality or chat modality) with the AI about a certain theme, idea, project, set of emotions, problems, issues they have been grappling with. 
Say they have carried a deep regret in heart, or some lingering pain from a heartbreak, or there is a challenge ahead of them for which they seek deep reserves of resolve and inspiration, or they want a “positive” emotions focused painting, with themes like hope, conviction, inspiration, beauty, joy, wonder, due to something they expect to happen soon - say the arrival of a child, or an upcoming adventure or trip of a lifetime. 


The AI and the user talk about this theme or topic, for a minute or 10. Once the conversation is completed, this is transcribed (if in voice modality; if chat modality, then the conversation is fed wholesale into the LLM for the next step) fed into an LLM to be converted into a detailed, comprehensive, richly textured and nuanced, hyperpersonalized, prompt, where none of the key details are missed from the conversation. This prompt is then fed into an image model/multimodal model. The results (3 options) are returned to the user.






Examples
Include friends, family, in your personal AI gen photos 




	

	

	Dream painter feature:
Works pretty similarly to the personal painter, with some key changes
The user lays out their dream in either of the 3 modes - input box, chat interface, or voice mode. 
The user is then asked how many paintings they want, and at what points of the dream - one image to capture the whole dream, 5 key visuals, some stills &one dynamic visual, etc
Based on this, the input is transformed into a rich prompt or multiple prompts for multiple visuals. 
The output is then displayed, for each desired state of the dream, and the user chooses one of more to savour, save, and the option to display it at a later time today.

	Story/personalized dynamic art [video, gifs, or sequence of images from shared arc or narrative] creation module:
Can be serendipitous - in a given timeframe, or at set times every day, or once the user taps on the Engage with a story button  


The user, upon clicking the Create a story features, gets asked if there are certain moods and themes they want the story to evoke in a text box - specific themes in a dropdown list - and whether they want a video [1 minute default] or a sequence of images [10 images, each shown for 6 seconds as the default]


The system then uses the user persona model to get personal relevant details to craft the story, a compelling, contextual narrative, using a creative writing model to write a short, powerful, emotive, moving, mood setting, contextual, and ultra personalized story arc, in the form of a video or a 1-0image sequence [unless the user wants it to be historical, mythical, symbolic, abstract, generic, for which we will add an option for the user to remove personalization [and thus no need to pass through the user model in this option] 


Later version will have a contextual music generation capability. 


The point of this feature is this: you know how kings used to commission painters to paint back in the day - we want to have our AI do that for our users, where they can have their story arcs, mood or narratives, be expressed in a dynamic format (sequence of coherent images or a one minute video, once that becomes usable)

	Labelling model 
This model takes images as an input, and generates associated metadata as the output - title, description, and many labels, for as many “objects” or “features” in the image. The output is image plus the stated metadata. 


Example:
We input an image depicting a man looking forlornly, with a hint of conviction on his face, on from a bridge with cars moving in the background, the crescent moon with shimmering stars, and reflections buildings with Victorian style architecture on the river. 
The output generated describes the scene in natural language: “The image depicts a man on a bridge looking on with a feeling of melancholy, tinged with resolve, as traffic zooms by behind him. The night sky….” 
The output also generates labels: “man”, “strong expressions”, “emotions”, “thoughtful”, “cars”, “river”, “bridge”, “stars”, “moon”, “Victorian architecture”, “reflections”, etc






	

	

	Poem visualization and narration feature:
In a chat window, the user asks the AI to find their favourite poem, based on a few lines, or based on the name. The AI retrieves the text. This text is converted into one prompt/n prompts for n images (we will cover dynamic visualizations - videos - in a later version), to visualize the poem.
The AI asks the user if they want the poem lyrics to be added to the visuals. It also asks the user if they want a rendition of it performed, and if so, in what voice - here, the user chooses a voice from many options.


Now, the system displays the visuals (pure symbolism, or representations of the lyrics, or alongside the lyrics expressed artistically in the visual medium). The model also narrates the poem in the preferred voice (accent, pitch, tone)


For instance:
The user asks the model to find Ozymandias. The model retrieves this and asks the user how many visuals, what style, with or without lines. The user chooses 4, the first two with the verses, the last 2 without. The model then asks if they’d also like the poem to be narrated. The users says yes, and chooses their preferred voice and accent. 


The model displays these images, and also narrates the poem.

	Image based synced smart lights feature: 
Our system analyses an image - its colour composition [a simple image analysis module will do just fine] - and based on that, adjusts the smart lights attached to our devices, to create a synced up, coherent, unifying, ambience. There are 8 different lights, and sycing up refers to what lights are turned on, and to what brightness, depending on the displayed painting or visual or video, in which case, the ambience can be dynamic. 
For instance, if the painting being displayed is the Scream, its colour composition requires blue and golden lights to be turned on. 


Image-based Smart Lights Feature Example
Example 1: Museum Display System
When a museum visitor approaches "The Starry Night" by Van Gogh:
                                                                                                                     1. Image Analysis:
                                                                                                                     * The system detects dominant colors: deep blues (40%), vibrant yellows (25%), cyan accents (15%), and dark greens (20%)
                                                                                                                     * Identifies swirling patterns and high contrast between light and dark elements
                                                                                                                     2. Light Orchestration:
                                                                                                                     * Lights 1 & 3: Set to deep blue at 80% brightness to reflect the night sky
                                                                                                                     * Lights 2 & 7: Set to yellow at 65% brightness, creating a pulsing effect (5-second intervals) to mimic the stars
                                                                                                                     * Lights 4 & 6: Set to cyan at 40% brightness for subtle accent
                                                                                                                     * Lights 5 & 8: Set to deep green at 30% brightness for grounding elements
                                                                                                                     * Overall effect: Room bathed in a dreamy, swirling atmosphere reminiscent of the painting
Example 2: Home Entertainment System
When a user watches "Mad Max: Fury Road" during an intense desert chase scene:
                                                                                                                     1. Dynamic Video Analysis (updating every 3 seconds):
                                                                                                                     * Frame dominant colors: orange-red (60%), tan/sand tones (25%), metallic grays (15%)
                                                                                                                     * Detects rapid movement and high-energy scene composition
                                                                                                                     2. Adaptive Light Response:
                                                                                                                     * Lights 1, 3, 5 & 7: Pulsing orange-red (70-90% brightness) synchronized with explosion sequences
                                                                                                                     * Lights 2 & 8: Set to sandy yellow at 50% brightness
                                                                                                                     * Lights 4 & 6: Set to metallic gray at 35% brightness
                                                                                                                     * During quieter scenes: Light intensity automatically reduces by 30%
                                                                                                                     * During action peaks: All lights briefly flash at 100% brightness


You won't have hardware access, so you can simulate the lighting effect through code 


You can keep the light static - so say for a red hued painting, only the red and orange lights are on, and the golden at 50% intensity - no pulsing though, if you want to reduce the complexity of the task


	

	

	Image-based music feature
We use a CV+LLM model to analyse an image [if it has metadata, including description, we can skip this step, but for most images, we should assume they won't] to generate its description. This could be a painting, or a photo. We then feed this description into our music library, where the pieces of music are stored with their own description. At this stage, the system should return 5 pieces of music most convergent with the emotive mood and themes and descriptions of the painting. 




Image-based Music Feature Example
Example 1: Art Gallery Audio Companion
When a visitor examines "The Persistence of Memory" by Salvador Dalí:
                                                                                                                     1. Image Analysis & Description Generation:
                                                                                                                     * CV+LLM analysis produces: "A surrealist dreamscape depicting melting pocket watches draped over barren branches and abstract shapes. The composition evokes themes of time's fluidity, dream states, and existential meditation. The color palette features soft blues, warm browns, and harsh shadows creating an atmospheric, otherworldly scene."
                                                                                                                     2. Music Library Matching:
                                                                                                                     * The system returns these 5 recommended pieces based on thematic convergence:
                                                                                                                     1. "Gymnopédie No.1" by Erik Satie (Description: "Minimalist piano piece evoking dreamlike contemplation with gentle, floating progressions")
                                                                                                                     2. "The Unanswered Question" by Charles Ives (Description: "Philosophical orchestral work exploring existential themes through contrasting sound textures")
                                                                                                                     3. "Time" by Hans Zimmer (Description: "Methodical, clock-like progressions building to emotional contemplation of time's passage")
                                                                                                                     4. "Metamorphosis One" by Philip Glass (Description: "Repetitive, evolving piano patterns creating a hypnotic, surreal atmosphere")
                                                                                                                     5. "Watermark" by Enya (Description: "Ethereal ambient composition with fluid, dreamlike qualities and otherworldly vocal textures")
Example 2: Photo-Sharing Application
When a user uploads a photograph of a stormy mountain landscape:
                                                                                                                     1. Image Analysis & Description Generation:
                                                                                                                     * CV+LLM analysis produces: "A dramatic mountain landscape captured during an approaching storm. Dark, heavy clouds loom over rugged peaks. Lightning illuminates portions of the scene, creating stark contrasts between light and shadow. The image conveys power, tension, and the raw force of nature, with a color palette dominated by deep grays, electric blues, and momentary flashes of white light."
                                                                                                                     2. Music Library Matching:
                                                                                                                     * The system returns these 5 recommended pieces:
                                                                                                                     1. "The Ride of the Valkyries" by Wagner (Description: "Powerful orchestral piece conveying dramatic tension and approaching conflict")
                                                                                                                     2. "Storm" from Four Seasons by Vivaldi (Description: "Dynamic string composition depicting turbulent weather and natural forces")
                                                                                                                     3. "Thunderstruck" by 2CELLOS (Description: "Intense, energetic instrumental cover capturing electric tension and explosive energy")
                                                                                                                     4. "Mountain" by Hans Zimmer (Description: "Epic orchestral piece conveying vast, imposing natural landscapes and their majesty")
                                                                                                                     5. "Lightning Crashes" by Live (Instrumental Version) (Description: "Emotional rock ballad with themes of natural cycles, tension, and release")


And for the first one, you can create a dummy db with 15 music pieces with descriptions to accomplish your task - should take a minute if you ask sonnet 3.7

	Visual/Image/Painting display script 
The system/TV app runs the script that displays the images/visuals/paintings according to the preferences set in the collection’s creation. The collection has a list of images, with metadata associated to each: time periods associated with each image, order of display, associated music or sound effects for the collection as a whole, or for each individual image, transition effects (blur, fade, door open, window open, dusting away, big crunch followed by big bang to fill up the screen with the new image, etc, etc.


	

	

	The TV app will have a way of storing the collections on the device, run without any wifi or internet connection. These collections will be displayed according to the preferences. 


The display algorithm takes in a collection as an input, and displays it according to the stipulations - time duration for each image, music which needs to be played, etc 


	

	

	Every Sunday, at 1pm, the mobile app checks if the TV is in close proximity. If so, then the mobile app sends over the collections for the next week, to the TV device, to be stored on the TV storage locally
